notes.zh: 看门狗：被系统清掉后约 1 分钟自动恢复；补报：恢复后补播停掉期间的到账，首页提示漏了几笔；自动更新。
notes.en: Watchdog: PesaBell comes back about a minute after the phone stops it. Payments that arrived while it was stopped are announced late and counted on the home screen. Automatic updates.
notes.sw: Mlinzi: PesaBell hurudi takriban dakika moja baada ya simu kuisimamisha. Malipo yaliyoingia ikiwa imesimamishwa hutangazwa baadaye. Masasisho ya kiotomatiki.
